source_scope: Supplied protocol and pinned publisher README only; no new login, archive access, rights adjudication, or payload decoding.
checks: 2_4 offset6, per-record spacing and documented slice range agree with README; unknown label depth remains bounded rather than invented.
Primary scoring domain covers all represented tissue-labelled voxels, independent of predicted support; abstentions remain false negatives.
Unlabelled zero and unannotated slices are excluded, not treated as negative labels; whole-brain precision/extraction accuracy not claimed.
Fixed ascending class mapping is sealed before label access; no permutation, offset search, retry or best-case selection.
Predicted/reference volumes and errors are explicitly conditional on labelled scoring domain E; undefined denominators remain NA.
Image-only support and known-positive fitting domain precede labels; no ground-truth brain-mask input permitted.
No invented world frame; raw axis/header validation and IBSR adapter/scorer remain prerequisites.
IBSR18 public-domain statement is not imported; project noncommercial eligibility and post-login conditions remain unresolved.
No authority to acquire, fit, admit training, accept anatomy/host, or generalize to IXI is created.
limitations: Reference agreement on one record is not independent generalization or IXI anatomical validation.
No scorer implementation exists yet; this checks prospective formulas and leakage rules, not executable scoring correctness.
External access/license statements are retained as supplied metadata evidence; no new legal conclusion or terms acceptance.
